summary.text: Danielle Ford, a nonpartisan first-term member of Nevada's State Board of Education and former Clark County School District trustee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Nevada to Aaron Ford, receiving 2.9% of the vote to Aaron Ford's 51.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
She said she wanted to be 'the education governor' and ran as an independent because she did not think the two-party system in Nevada was successful at the moment.
